title: MCP describe_metadata：已停用的流程仍显示「active」，AI 会据此说流程在运行
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX11yNi4DyGhuzqBpV

Found in the acceptance run for objectstack#35442 (result comment 7122547546 on objectstack#36843), same local stack.

**What happens.** With HotCRM's `opportunity_approval` and `opportunity_approval_on_create` switched off through `POST /api/v1/automation/NAME/toggle {enabled:false}` (200), `describe_metadata` still answers `status: 'active'` with no enabled flag. Asked 「商机的审批流程是怎样的？」 on the build door, the agent then answered that large-deal approval runs by default. The app-docs answer order (#35564) tells the agent "the definition is what runs", but a switched-off flow does not run, and nothing on the MCP connection shows the switch. (Both flows were switched back on after the run.)

## 维护者速读

- 问题：管理员把审批流程关掉后，外接 AI 读到的流程定义仍写着「启用」，于是告诉用户「大额商机要审批」，其实已经不审批了。
- 要做的：describe_metadata（或回答顺序说明）带上流程当前是否启用，AI 回答时说明流程已停用。

## Done when

A switched-off flow is visible as disabled to an MCP definition reader, and the answer-order text tells the agent to say so; a test pins it.

Related: objectstack#35442
